title: Dynamic Rent Pricing for Multifamily

blueprintSignals.name: Inquiry velocity
blueprintSignals.definition: enquiries per day for the unit type over 7 days divided by the 28-day mean
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Noise from marketing campaigns, so adjust for ad spend

blueprintSignals.name: Occupancy vs target
blueprintSignals.definition: current occupancy minus the target occupancy for the date
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Occupancy definitions differ between systems, so use one definition

blueprintSignals.name: Competitor asking rents
blueprintSignals.definition: median public asking rent of comparable units within 1 km
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Asking prices differ from signed rents, so apply a historical discount

blueprintSignals.name: Expiry schedule
blueprintSignals.definition: number of leases expiring per month over the next 12 months
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Early terminations alter the schedule, so refresh it daily

engineFeatures.meaning: what has been delivered so far, seen after a delay
the demand available each step, which the controller does not control

label: For "Dynamic Rent Pricing for Multifamily": Set daily asking rents by unit type to maximise revenue subject to occupancy and fairness rules. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: A simulated demand curve is optimistic about how tenants react to price.
